items.question: What was the ROI of each campaign that started in 2025 (attributed net revenue divided by budget)?
items.sql:
SELECT
  c.name AS campaign_name,
  c.budget_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue_usd), 0) AS total_net_revenue_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN c.budget_usd > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue_usd), 0) / c.budget_usd, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS campaign_roi
FROM campaigns c
LEFT JOIN order_revenue o ON o.campaign_id = c.id
WHERE c.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND c.start_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.budget_usd
ORDER BY campaign_roi DESC NULLS LAST;

items.question: What was net revenue by region last calendar quarter vs the one before?
items.sql:
WITH quarterly_data AS (
  SELECT
    region_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 'Q2 2026'
      WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 'Q3 2026'
    END AS period,
    SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY region_name, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    region_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'Q2 2026' THEN net_revenue_usd END) AS q2_2026_net_revenue_usd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'Q3 2026' THEN net_revenue_usd END) AS q3_2026_net_revenue_usd
  FROM quarterly_data
  GROUP BY region_name
)
SELECT
  region_name,
  ROUND(q2_2026_net_revenue_usd, 2) AS q2_2026_net_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(q3_2026_net_revenue_usd, 2) AS q3_2026_net_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(q3_2026_net_revenue_usd - q2_2026_net_revenue_usd, 2) AS net_revenue_diff_usd,
  ROUND(
    (q3_2026_net_revenue_usd - q2_2026_net_revenue_usd) / NULLIF(q2_2026_net_revenue_usd, 0),
    4
  ) AS pct_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY region_name;

items.question: Compare net revenue in 2025 with 2024
items.sql:
WITH yearly_rev AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ordered_at)::int AS order_year,
    SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS total_net_revenue
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN total_net_revenue END) AS net_revenue_2024,
  MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN total_net_revenue END) AS net_revenue_2025,
  MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN total_net_revenue END) - MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN total_net_revenue END) AS revenue_diff,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN total_net_revenue END) - MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN total_net_revenue END))
    / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN total_net_revenue END), 0),
    4
  ) AS pct_change
FROM yearly_rev;

items.question: How did the number of orders in each region change between calendar Q2 2026 and Q3 2026?
items.sql:
WITH quarterly_orders AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    CASE
      WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 'Q2_2026'
      WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 'Q3_2026'
    END AS quarter,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY region_code, quarter
)
SELECT
  q2.region_code,
  COALESCE(q2.order_count, 0) AS q2_2026_orders,
  COALESCE(q3.order_count, 0) AS q3_2026_orders,
  COALESCE(q3.order_count, 0) - COALESCE(q2.order_count, 0) AS order_count_diff,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(q2.order_count, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(q3.order_count, 0) - COALESCE(q2.order_count, 0))::numeric / COALESCE(q2.order_count, 0), 4)
  END AS pct_change
FROM
  (SELECT region_code, order_count FROM quarterly_orders WHERE quarter = 'Q2_2026') q2
FULL OUTER JOIN
  (SELECT region_code, order_count FROM quarterly_orders WHERE quarter = 'Q3_2026') q3
ON q2.region_code = q3.region_code
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: Year over year, how did net revenue in calendar Q3 2026 compare with calendar Q3 2025 for each region?
items.sql:
WITH quarterly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    CASE
      WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2025-10-01' THEN 'Q3 2025'
      WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 'Q3 2026'
    END AS period,
    SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS net_rev
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE
    (ordered_at >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2025-10-01')
    OR
    (ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01')
  GROUP BY region_code, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'Q3 2025' THEN net_rev ELSE 0 END) AS q3_2025_net_revenue_usd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'Q3 2026' THEN net_rev ELSE 0 END) AS q3_2026_net_revenue_usd
  FROM quarterly_revenue
  GROUP BY region_code
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  ROUND(q3_2025_net_revenue_usd, 2) AS q3_2025_net_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(q3_2026_net_revenue_usd, 2) AS q3_2026_net_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(q3_2026_net_revenue_usd - q3_2025_net_revenue_usd, 2) AS net_revenue_change_usd,
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN q3_2025_net_revenue_usd = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (q3_2026_net_revenue_usd - q3_2025_net_revenue_usd) / q3_2025_net_revenue_usd
    END, 4
  ) AS pct_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: What was the refund rate in each region in 2025 compared with 2026 so far?
items.sql:
WITH yearly_rates AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ordered_at)::int AS yr,
    SUM(refund_usd) AS total_refunds,
    SUM(gross_revenue_usd) AS total_gross,
    ROUND(
      SUM(refund_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_revenue_usd), 0),
      4
    ) AS refund_rate
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND ordered_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
  GROUP BY region_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ordered_at)::int
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN refund_rate END) AS refund_rate_2025,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2026 THEN refund_rate END) AS refund_rate_2026_ytd
  FROM yearly_rates
  GROUP BY region_code
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  refund_rate_2025,
  refund_rate_2026_ytd,
  ROUND(refund_rate_2026_ytd - refund_rate_2025, 4) AS diff,
  ROUND(
    (refund_rate_2026_ytd - refund_rate_2025) / NULLIF(refund_rate_2025, 0),
    4
  ) AS pct_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY region_code;

items.question: Compare subscription revenue in fiscal Q2 of FY2027 with fiscal Q1 of FY2027
items.sql:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN period_start >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND period_start < DATE '2026-05-01' THEN 'FY2027_Q1'
      WHEN period_start >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND period_start < DATE '2026-08-01' THEN 'FY2027_Q2'
    END AS fiscal_quarter,
    SUM(amount_usd) AS total_revenue_usd
  FROM subscription_revenue
  WHERE period_start >= DATE '2026-02-01'
    AND period_start < DATE '2026-08-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_quarter = 'FY2027_Q1' THEN total_revenue_usd END) AS fy2027_q1_revenue_usd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_quarter = 'FY2027_Q2' THEN total_revenue_usd END) AS fy2027_q2_revenue_usd
  FROM rev
)
SELECT
  ROUND(fy2027_q1_revenue_usd, 2) AS fy2027_q1_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(fy2027_q2_revenue_usd, 2) AS fy2027_q2_revenue_usd,
  ROUND(fy2027_q2_revenue_usd - fy2027_q1_revenue_usd, 2) AS revenue_difference_usd,
  ROUND(
    CASE
      WHEN fy2027_q1_revenue_usd IS NOT NULL AND fy2027_q1_revenue_usd <> 0
      THEN (fy2027_q2_revenue_usd - fy2027_q1_revenue_usd) / fy2027_q1_revenue_usd
      ELSE NULL
    END, 4
  ) AS pct_change
FROM pivoted;

items.question: Did average net order value go up or down from 2024 to 2025 in each customer segment?
items.sql:
WITH yearly_aov AS (
  SELECT
    customer_segment,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ordered_at)::int AS order_year,
    SUM(net_revenue_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS avg_net_order_value
  FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY customer_segment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ordered_at)::int
)
SELECT
  customer_segment,
  MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN avg_net_order_value END) AS aov_2024,
  MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN avg_net_order_value END) AS aov_2025,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN avg_net_order_value END) - MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN avg_net_order_value END), 2) AS diff_usd,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN avg_net_order_value END) - MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN avg_net_order_value END))
    / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN avg_net_order_value END), 0),
    4
  ) AS pct_change
FROM yearly_aov
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_segment;

items.question: Which customers placed the most orders in 2025? Show the top 5, including anyone tied with the fifth.
items.sql:
WITH customer_orders_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    orv.customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM order_revenue orv
  WHERE orv.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND orv.ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY orv.customer_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
  SELECT
    co.customer_id,
    cp.customer_name,
    co.order_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.order_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM customer_orders_2025 co
  JOIN customer_profile cp ON co.customer_id = cp.customer_id
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  order_count
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rnk <= 5
ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer_name ASC;

items.question: For each first-order month in 2025, how many new customers were there and how many of them placed another order within 60 days?
items.sql:
WITH new_customers_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    cp.customer_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', cp.first_order_at)::date AS first_order_month,
    cp.first_order_at
  FROM customer_profile cp
  WHERE cp.first_order_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND cp.first_order_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
reorders AS (
  SELECT
    nc.customer_id,
    nc.first_order_month,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM order_revenue orv
        WHERE orv.customer_id = nc.customer_id
          AND orv.ordered_at > nc.first_order_at
          AND orv.ordered_at <= nc.first_order_at + INTERVAL '60 days'
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS has_reorder_within_60_days
  FROM new_customers_2025 nc
)
SELECT
  first_order_month,
  COUNT(*) AS new_customers,
  SUM(has_reorder_within_60_days) AS customers_with_reorder_within_60_days
FROM reorders
GROUP BY first_order_month
ORDER BY first_order_month ASC;

items.question: How many units of each product in the Lamps category did we sell in 2026 so far?
items.sql:
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  SUM(units) AS total_units_sold
FROM order_line_revenue
WHERE category_name = 'Lamps'
  AND ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND ordered_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY product_id, product_name
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC;
